rec.name: PDP Product Tabs (Expandable Image Cards)
rec.status: Built — launched (documented; product image for docs added later)

what.text: A Shopify section named 'CRO | PDP Producttabs' for the product page. It shows a row of rounded cards, each with an image, a heading, and an optional description and button/link. Cards expand and collapse like an accordion, using a +/− icon beside the heading. In the reference, the collapsed cards show only image + title, and the open card reveals its description. An optional CTA pill button (e.g. 'Discover key features') sits below the cards. Content is unique per product.

why.text: Image-led cards let shoppers scan product benefits visually and open only the ones that interest them. This reduces text overload and keeps the page short, while still giving depth on demand (progressive disclosure). Benefit-led headings communicate value and answer objections near the buy decision. The optional CTA gives engaged shoppers a clear next step. Mechanism is inferred; the ticket does not state a rationale.

how.text: Create the section file cro_pdp_product_tabs.liquid and paste the supplied code. The section has blocks for subheading, heading, content (rich text) and image, with per-block typography and spacing controlled via CSS variables. The cards live in a 3-column grid (.cro_pdp_product_tabs_list) with rounded corners (.cro_pdp_product_tabs__item). Colors fall back to global theme settings when the section color is transparent. Per-product content is delivered through a metaobject plus product metafield, set up by the developer (details are in the plain-text install instructions and the Slite doc, not fully visible in the source). Accordion behavior must expose aria-expanded and aria-controls, keyboard focus, and WCAG AA contrast. Cards stack on mobile (breakpoint at 1000px).

items: Accordion mode: other cards stay open or auto-close (per acceptance criteria)
Card content: image, title, optional text, optional button/link (editable in customizer)
Card-only mode: image + heading with no text
Section text color and background (fall back to theme)
Collapsible card text color, background, corner radius (desktop/mobile)
Collapsible title and content font size (desktop/mobile)
Row gap and column gap between cards (desktop/mobile)
Optional custom max width for the container
Subheading, heading and content blocks: font size, weight, line height, letter spacing, transform, spacing, max width and alignment
Image block: corner radius and spacing (desktop/mobile)
Optional CTA: inside the opened card or global below the section, with an individual URL per button
Modal-related styling variables (button colors, popup colors, title/heading/content sizes) exist in the code, though a modal is not described in the ticket

dependencies.text: Metaobject and product metafield setup for unique content per product (confirmed in comments). Theme global settings: text_color, background, heading_color. Theme .container class. A product image was requested for the docs. Exact metaobject definition is not included in the source.

metrics: Scroll depth and engagement on the PDP

images.caption: Reference layout: three rounded gray cards with image on top, uppercase title and +/− icon. The middle card is expanded with a description; a pill CTA ('Discover key features +') sits below the cards. The right card shows a keyboard focus ring.
